knowledge.title: NIT Durgapur Hostel Leave & Gate Pass Procedure (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: Students must submit an official leave request with parent/guardian consent at least 24 hours in advance to obtain an approved digital or physical gate pass.
knowledge.content:
1. Fill out the prescribed Hostel Leave Application form or submit the request on the Hall Management System / Warden portal.
2. Provide written parental or local guardian consent (signed letter or registered parent email/SMS confirmation).
3. Obtain signature / digital approval from the respective Hall Warden or Caretaker.
4. Show the approved gate pass and student ID card at the hostel main security gate before departing.
5. Upon return, report to the security desk / hostel register to record your arrival time.

knowledge.title: Hostel Room Change & Mutual Swap Procedure (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: Room changes are permitted only on valid medical grounds or mutual exchange between eligible students of the same year and hall with Warden approval.
knowledge.content:
1. For mutual exchange: Both students must submit a joint application specifying their current room numbers and reasons.
2. For individual requests: Submit a written application addressed to the Hall Warden detailing compelling reasons (e.g., medical recommendation verified by Institute Medical Officer).
3. Room changes during mid-semester are strictly discouraged except for verified emergencies.
4. Once approved, coordinate with the Hall Caretaker for inventory check and handover of room keys.

knowledge.title: Hostel Mess Complaints and Rebate Guidelines (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: Mess grievances should be recorded in the Hall Mess Register and escalated to the student Mess Committee and Hall Warden.
knowledge.content:
1. Immediate feedback: Log your complaint in the physical Mess Complaint Register available in the hall dining area.
2. Contact the student Mess Representative / Mess Secretary of your hall to bring up the issue with the caterer during weekly review.
3. For persistent quality or hygiene lapses, submit a written report to the Hall Warden with date, meal time, and specifics.
4. Mess Rebate: For approved leaves exceeding 5 consecutive days, apply for mess rebate through the Warden office at least 3 days in advance.

knowledge.title: Hostel Electrical Maintenance & Repair Procedure (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: Electrical faults must be entered in the Hall Maintenance Register at the caretaker desk for scheduled daily repairs by the Institute Estate Section.
knowledge.content:
1. Visit your Hall Caretaker's office / security desk.
2. Write down your Hall Number, Room Number, exact nature of fault (e.g., fan capacitor, socket, light), and contact number in the Maintenance Register.
3. The Institute Estate Section electricians inspect and service rooms between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM on working days.
4. For emergency hazards (such as sparks, short circuits, or smoking cables), immediately alert the Caretaker or security guard for emergency breaker shutdown.

knowledge.title: NIT Durgapur Hostel Facilities, Rules & Discipline Code (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: Information regarding NIT Durgapur hostel facilities, room amenities, Wi-Fi, common rooms, security, curfew timings, and discipline code.
knowledge.content:
1. Facilities & Amenities: Hostels provide basic furniture (cot, study table, chair, almirah), 24x7 security, water purifiers with water coolers, geysers in winter, high-speed Wi-Fi, and indoor recreation / TV common rooms.
2. Curfew Timings: Normal gate closing is 10:00 PM (verify specific hall notice for semester variations). Late entries require signing the Late Register with valid reason.
3. Guest Policy: Outside visitors and day scholars are strictly prohibited from entering boarder rooms. Parents may use Institute Guest House upon prior reservation.
4. Electric Appliances: High-power appliances (heaters, induction stoves, immersion rods) are strictly prohibited inside student rooms.
5. Anti-Ragging: Strict zero-tolerance policy. Any incident must be immediately reported to the Anti-Ragging Committee or Chief Warden.
6. Quiet Hours: 11:00 PM to 6:00 AM must be observed as quiet hours for study and rest.

knowledge.title: NIT Durgapur Semester Course Registration Procedure (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: Every student must complete online course registration through the Institute Academic ERP (Chanakya portal) at the beginning of each semester after clearing institute dues.
knowledge.content:
1. Pay the prescribed semester fees via the official State Bank Collect / designated payment gateway.
2. Log into the Chanakya ERP portal using your student credentials.
3. Select core subjects, professional electives, and open electives as per the curriculum for your department and semester.
4. Submit the registration draft for Faculty Advisor / Head of Department (HOD) approval.
5. Download and print the finalized Registration Slip for your personal record once approved.
6. Late registration is permitted only within the late registration window announced in the Academic Calendar upon payment of late fee.

knowledge.title: NIT Durgapur Examination Guidelines & Regulations (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: Examinations consist of Continuous Assessment, Mid-Semester (30 marks), and End-Semester (50 marks). Students must possess a valid admit card and student ID.
knowledge.content:
1. Admit Card: Download and print the exam admit card from the Chanakya portal before the commencement of examinations.
2. Reporting Time: Arrive at the designated examination hall at least 15 minutes before the scheduled start.
3. Prohibited Items: Mobile phones, smartwatches, programmable calculators, and unauthorized materials are strictly forbidden inside the hall.
4. Medical Absence: If an exam is missed due to acute illness, submit a medical certificate verified by the NITD Medical Officer to the Dean (Academic) within 3 working days.
5. Supplementary Exams: Held during summer break for students with 'F' grade who fulfill the minimum attendance requirement.
knowledge.detailed_procedure:
1. Admit Card: Download and print the exam admit card from the Chanakya portal before the commencement of examinations.
2. Reporting Time: Arrive at the designated examination hall at least 15 minutes before the scheduled start.

4. Medical Absence: If an exam is missed due to acute illness, submit a medical certificate verified by the NITD Medical Officer to the Dean (Academic) within 3 working days.
5. Supplementary Exams: Held during summer break for students with 'F' grade who fulfill the minimum attendance requirement.

knowledge.title: NIT Durgapur Academic Attendance Regulations (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: A minimum of 75% attendance in each registered theory and laboratory subject is mandatory to be eligible to appear in the End-Semester Examination.
knowledge.content:
1. Standard Requirement: Every student must attend a minimum of 75% of classes held in each subject.
2. Attendance Condonation: Condonation of up to 10% (i.e. between 65% and 75%) may be considered by the Dean (Academic) strictly for authorized institute representation or verified medical hospitalization.
3. Medical Leave Intimation: Medical certificates from external hospitals must be countersigned by the Chief Medical Officer (CMO), NIT Durgapur Health Centre within 7 days of returning.
4. Debarment: Students having less than the required attendance will be awarded a 'Debarred' (W/F) status and will not be permitted to write the end-semester exam for that subject.

2. Attendance Condonation: Condonation of up to 10% (i.e. between 65% and 75%) may be considered by the Dean (Academic) strictly for authorized institute representation or verified medical hospitalization.
3. Medical Leave Intimation: Medical certificates from external hospitals must be countersigned by the Chief Medical Officer (CMO), NIT Durgapur Health Centre within 7 days of returning.
4. Debarment: Students having less than the required attendance will be awarded a 'Debarred' (W/F) status and will not be permitted to write the end-semester exam for that subject.

knowledge.title: NIT Durgapur Academic Certificates & Transcripts Procedure (Demo Record)
knowledge.summary: Certificates including Bonafide, Transcripts, and Internship NOCs can be requested through prescribed application forms submitted to the Academic Section.
knowledge.content:
1. Bonafide Certificate: Submit an application addressed to the Assistant Registrar (Academic) mentioning your Roll Number, Department, and purpose. Processing takes 2-3 working days.
2. Official Transcripts: Pay the transcript fee on SBI Collect, attach copies of all grade cards, and submit the transcript requisition form to the Academic Section.
3. Internship NOC: Obtain the training/internship offer letter, submit the NOC requisition form endorsed by your Department Head (HOD) and T&P (Training & Placement) Cell.
4. Collection: Collect signed and stamped original documents from the Academic Section counter during student counter hours (2:00 PM to 4:00 PM).
